test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2023: Official Paper (Held On: 11 Aug, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
In the context of ecology, the given equation shows the relationship between the size of an area and the number of species present in it. Accordingly, by which letter is the regression coefficient denoted?

log S = log C + Z log A
solution:
The correct answer is __**Z.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The** regression coefficient **in the given equation is denoted by the **letter Z.**
 
• The equation is known as the **species-area relationship** and is used to predict the number of species present in a given area based on its size.
 
• The coefficient Z represents the **slope of the regression line** and measures the **rate** at which the number of **species increases** with** increasing area.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The** constant C** represents the intercept of the** regression line **and represents the** number of species** present in a unit area.
 
• **S** represents the** number of species.**
 
• **A** represents the **size of the area.**
 
• In general, there are more plant and animal species on** larger lands** than on smaller ones.
 
• Almost all terrestrial systems that have been investigated, from vast** continental regions** to **island archipelagos,** have shown this link to hold true.
